snippet.title: Apartment - Obra Dinn-inspired game about returning to your apartment after the lockdown!
snippet.description:
Download for free on itch.io https://freeplayfest.itch.io/apartment?ac=qfCyYFQF-yt You’re invited to my place~
When all this began, I left my home and most of my belongings behind.
My apartment, recreated from memory.
